verdict.rationale: Apple documents concrete external I/O specs (three Thunderbolt 5 ports at up to 120Gb/s, USB4 support, multi-display output, unified memory bandwidth) that a developer could plan a dock/build around, but there is no documented PCIe generation/lane count or SSD/storage throughput specs anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: PCIe generation/lane count, internal storage/SSD read-write specs, independent teardown/lab verification of I/O throughput.
